children: Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRVL) is riding AI and hyperscale demand—Q revenue hit $2.74B with data-center sales up 46%—while unveiling 2nm optical interconnects and launching Azure Payment HSM v2, as analysts and investors forecast a multibillion TAM and steep upside.
Marvell Q Revenue Growth Driven By Data-Center AI
: Marvell (MRVL) posted Q revenue $2.74B; data-center sales rose 46% YoY, driven by AI data-center demand, with data-center growth a major contributor to quarterly revenue.
: Marvell (MRVL) showcased 2nm optical interconnects at ECOC 2026: 400G-per-lane PAM4, 800G ZR/ZR+ coherent OSFP with MACsec, and 1.6T ZR/coherent-lite variants for AI and hyperscale networks.
BoA Sees Large TAM, XPU Market
: Bank of America met Marvell execs; firm estimates Marvell TAM ~$55B by 2028 and sees potential to capture ~$30B of a $60–65B XPU attach market by 2030; $365 price target.
: Marvell (MRVL) launched Azure Payment HSM v2 with LiquidSecurity HSMs and Utimaco Atalla software. Public preview starts Sept 17, 2026 in Western US and Western Europe for cloud payment HSMs.
: InfraCap chief Jay Hatfield named Marvell Technology (MRVL) his “pick of the year” and “pick of the decade,” setting a $300 price target, implying about 35% upside from then levels.
